shots.title: 触摸倒影
shots.prompt: An ancient Chinese woman in elegant hanfu stands before a modern glass building window at night. She reaches out and touches the glass surface, her fingers tracing the reflection of herself - but the reflection shows her wearing modern clothes. She looks confused and turns around to see a young modern woman with warm smile standing behind her. The modern woman says gently: 'This is 21st century Shanghai.' The ancient woman looks shocked: '21st century... am I dreaming?' Cinematic lighting, emotional close-up, shallow depth of field.

audio_nodes.node_166_character: ancient Chinese woman hanfu silver jewelry, confused expression
audio_nodes.node_138_prompt: She touches glass window, sees modern reflection, turns to see modern woman

shots.title: 咖啡厅相遇
shots.prompt: Inside a modern chic cafe at night. The ancient woman stands before an espresso machine, looking at it with curiosity and wonder. A young female barista with warm smile approaches and offers her a cup of coffee. The ancient woman asks: 'What is this machine?' The barista replies: 'This is a coffee machine, would you like to try?' The ancient woman smells the coffee and asks: 'What does coffee taste like?' Warm cafe lighting, cinematic composition, close-up shots.

audio_nodes.node_166_character: ancient woman curious expression + modern barista friendly
audio_nodes.node_138_prompt: She examines coffee machine, barista offers coffee, she smells it curiously

shots.title: 时空交汇
shots.prompt: Epic fantasy scene. The ancient woman and modern woman stand facing each other in a cafe, holding hands. Magical golden light swirls around them as temporal energy manifests. The ancient woman says with tears in her eyes: 'I want to go back to my era.' The modern woman replies warmly: 'It's okay, we will meet again.' They smile at each other as the light grows brighter, preparing for the departure. Cinematic epic lighting, emotional farewell, magical atmosphere.

audio_nodes.node_166_character: ancient woman tearful + modern woman comforting
